_doc: Mercedes wave PASSES, 2026-08-11 -- 70 distinct meshes out of 196 audited sheets. Exact face-count duplicates and the one nameplate-conflict pair are EXCLUDED; see MERCEDES_DUPES.json. ACCURACY RULE: year/generation/trim are transcribed from the SOURCE TITLE only and are null where the title does not state them -- nothing here is inferred from the render. NOT CLEARED FOR TYRES: no car here has had its tyres decided, because the glTF cannot see the per-corner white-tyre artefact (tyre_probe scored 0/8 recall against ground truth) and the sheet is a candidate finder only. A RED control render is still owed before any of these ship.
